shared_elements: low relief carving of figures on a flat vertical surface
repeated row of similar motifs forming a band
human or humanoid arms/hands rendered on the body
justification: Both are low reliefs containing profile animal forms and a horizontally repeated band of similar motifs, but that is about as generic as shared content gets. A shows a single naturalistic, richly detailed standing human in patterned robe with headdress holding a spear and bow, while B shows a schematic abstracted pillar-like form with stacked registers of highly stylised beasts, birds and a snake-like creature, with no human figure of the same type and completely different proportion and detailing conventions.
